summary: Untitled Goose Game entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Untitled Goose Game
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release with the free two-player update

primary.version: Current PC release with the two-player update
primary.why: The PC route is the cleanest capture path and the current releases share the same core campaign. The free two-player update should be included because it lets the whole game be played cooperatively without changing the level set.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam, Itch, or Epic PC build. Record storefront, build/date, input device, language, achievement state, whether two-player mode was used, and capture settings.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record storefront and update state. The Steam release date differs from the original 2019 launch because the Steam build arrived later.
